description: Free, open source, cross-platform audio software for multi-track recording and editing (legacy version)
notes: Mirrored via the Internet Archive's 'Audacity Archive Up to Version 2.4.2' collection (archive.org/details/AudacityArchive), which the uploader states was obtained directly from FossHub/Google Code/Audacity's GitHub and left untouched. This avoids FossHub's expiring genLink download URLs, which are not stable enough for a scoop manifest. Before relying on this manifest, verify the hash yourself once with 'scoop install' or 'certutil -hashfile audacity-win-2.4.1.exe SHA256' -- it should match dde069264974b3bf7a0b556ea3037bb424630e3112735f99129f3d84921e547f, the SHA256 published on Audacity's own support site (support.audacityteam.org). Source code for GPL compliance: https://github.com/audacity/audacity/releases/tag/Audacity-2.4.1 (source zip/tar.xz assets).
